messages:
Ruth (SRE): Follow-up from last night's short latency bursts. Pattern: brief 5-12m p95 jumps tied to a few heavy callers. Need owners, a narrow SLO safety plan, and action tracking.

Ben (Platform): Two tracks: immediate guardrails (rate-limit top callers, small quantized fallback) + medium-term (cache TTL hardening + edge shaping). What SLO change do you propose?

Ruth (SRE): Temporary safety SLO for 14 days: public p95 <= 320ms (was 200ms) but only for non-enterprise keys. Enterprise SLA unchanged. If 72h burn-rate > 1.3 -> pause non-critical rollouts.

Clara (Product): We need a clear mapping of which tenants are enterprise vs public. I'll produce the list and comms template.

Owen (Service Owner): I'll own degraded-path definitions for /generate and /embed: reduced-precision embeddings + async fallback for non-critical features. ETA 2d.

Ben (Platform): Action items: 1) Ben: implement 2% quantized fallback + label routing (today) 2) Ruth: add burn-rate alert + playbook snippet to dashboard (today) 3) Owen: degradation policy doc (2d) 4) Clara: customer comms + enterprise list (tomorrow). ops-bot: please create a checkpoint.

ops-bot: Created event "SLO safety checkpoint" Mon 09:30 PT and alert rule p95 burn-rate > 1.2 -> notify #eng-platform + oncall.

Ruth (SRE): Added PromQL to dashboard: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, api_key, route)). Also added top-callers CSV export. Will update postmortem tracker by EOD.

Ben (Platform): PR opened for routing fallback: https://git.internal/routing/PR-900. Will keep fallback scoped to non-enterprise keys until Clara confirms list.

Clara (Product): I'll post the enterprise list and the comms draft to #customer-ops today. We'll only enable fallback for public keys after Sales ack.

Ruth (SRE): Reconvene in 24h to review error-budget trend. Prefer graceful degradation > loosening SLAs. Follow-up in this thread.
